description: Reusable delivery presets for the David Nigerian English cinematic documentary voice. Presets change engine-native controls where available and fall back to punctuation, segmentation and pacing where they are not.

documentary_hook.label: Documentary hook
documentary_hook.description: Confident, engaging, intriguing, emotionally expressive opening.
documentary_hook.punctuation: Short first sentence. One concrete detail. End on a question or a turn.

business_explanation.label: Business explanation
business_explanation.punctuation: One idea per sentence. Keep clauses under 18 words. Use commas for breath.

tension.label: Tension
tension.punctuation: Short sentences. Periods instead of commas. Let the silence work.

revelation.label: Revelation
revelation.description: Emphasise the important discovery or turning point.
revelation.punctuation: Build to one stressed noun. Put the discovery in its own sentence.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.punctuation: Longer clauses, soft commas, no hard sell.

conclusion.label: Conclusion
conclusion.punctuation: One memorable line. One clear CTA. Stop before the brand reveal.
